title: Grading
description: Grade breakdown keyed by category — the evaluation components and the formula for the final grade that Meredith requires on the syllabus. Every graded activity needs its own category, and the weights MUST total 100%; the build warns when they do not. The PRESENCE of `homework`, `project`, and `final` keys toggles related copy in templates, so key names are part of the contract. Key order is display order.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

participation.description: In-class credit (labs, participation). If this category exists, attendance affects the grade, and Meredith requires policies.attendance to state expectations AND consequences.

final.description: The final exam — the culminating experience Meredith strongly encourages during the exam period. Its presence renders the exam-slot copy from schedule.finalExam (or the exam-period fallback until the registrar publishes the slot).

title.description: Category heading as shown on the syllabus.

weight.description: Share of the final grade, as a percentage string. All categories together must total 100%.

body.description: Policy prose for the category (due dates, make-up rules, late-work pointer).
